scope: Disposable local Supabase: real GoTrue and PostgREST; no hosted user or real payment

events.name: Two independent students authenticate through real HTTP GoTrue
Authenticated users cannot learn or enable Premium before server verification
A second HTTP session resumes the exact saved lesson and history of the same identity
Simultaneous sessions receive version conflicts instead of silently losing the first device draft
Forged owner fields do not copy or overwrite another student progress
Private schemas, service billing commands and unapproved storage keys stay denied over PostgREST
A service-side checkout is also closed until merchant and tax readiness are enabled
Restoring production mode rejects the same isolated test grants for Android and web
Account deletion without Premium removes synchronized progress and revokes the other live session
